meta.title: Terrenos Bragado — Titled land plots in the heart of the province
meta.description: Planned land developments in Bragado. Serviced plots, in-house financing and guaranteed title deeds.

hero.eyebrow: Land developments in Bragado, Buenos Aires
hero.title: Your next square metre already has coordinates
hero.subtitle: We develop land with utilities, finished streets and guaranteed title deeds. Pick your plot, review the payment plan and start building where you actually want to live.

projects.title: Developments on sale
projects.subtitle: Every development has an approved survey, finished streets and its own payment plan. The data in this grid is sample content.

p1.name: Los Álamos
p1.desc: Residential development with 84 plots and mature tree cover along the main avenue.

p2.name: Santa Rosa
p2.desc: Generous blocks ten minutes from downtown, with power and water at the property line.

p3.name: El Mirador
p3.desc: Elevated plots with open countryside views and internal streets already opened.

p4.name: Las Acacias
p4.desc: Family-oriented development with a central green space and 12-metre frontages.

p5.name: Don Bosco
p5.desc: Mixed-use parcels on a paved access road, well suited to retail.

p6.name: La Estancia
p6.desc: Large semi-rural plots designed for country houses and home gardens.

upcoming.title: Upcoming projects
upcoming.subtitle: Developments awaiting approval. They are not on sale yet — leave your details and we will let you know when the pre-sale opens.

u1.name: Ribera Norte
u1.desc: Riverside development with a green setback and a planned cycle path.

u2.name: Altos del Parque
u2.desc: Second phase bordering the municipal park, currently being surveyed.

u3.name: Camino Real
u3.desc: Parcels along the historic access road, pending utility feasibility.
